Title: Login with empty username and password
Preconditions: User is on the Login page (not authenticated)
Steps: 1. Leave Username field empty. 2. Leave Password field empty. 3. Click Login button.
Expected Result: Form does not submit; ""Required"" validation message is shown under both Username and Password fields; user remains on Login page.
Actual Result: Required validation shown as expected; user remains on Login page.

Title: Login with valid username but empty password
Preconditions: User is on the Login page
Steps: 1. Enter a valid username (e.g. Admin). 2. Leave Password field empty. 3. Click Login button.
Expected Result: Form does not submit; ""Required"" validation message is shown under Password field only.

Title: Login field accepts special characters / script injection attempt
Preconditions: User is on the Login page
Steps: 1. Enter <script>alert(1)</script> in Username field. 2. Enter any value in Password field. 3. Click Login.
Expected Result: Login is rejected with a generic ""Invalid credentials"" message; input is not executed or reflected unescaped anywhere on the page.
Actual Result: Generic invalid-credentials message shown; no script execution observed.

Title: Unauthorized direct access to a protected module URL
Preconditions: User is logged out (no active session)
Steps: 1. With no active session paste the direct URL .../web/index.php/admin/viewSystemUsers into the browser address bar and navigate.
Expected Result: User is redirected to the Login page instead of the Admin/User Management screen.
Actual Result: User redirected to Login page as expected.

Title: Session ends correctly after Logout then Back navigation
Steps: 1. Log in successfully. 2. Click Logout. 3. Click the browser Back button.
Expected Result: User is not shown the previous authenticated Dashboard from cache; app either shows Login page or re-prompts for credentials if a protected page is requested.
Actual Result: Login page shown; no cached authenticated page accessible.

Title: Add employee with empty First Name
Preconditions: User is logged in and on PIM > Add Employee
Steps: 1. Leave First Name field empty. 2. Fill Last Name field. 3. Click Save.
Expected Result: Form does not submit; ""Required"" validation message shown under First Name field.

Title: Add employee with special characters in name fields
Preconditions: User is logged in and on PIM > Add Employee
Steps: 1. Enter "<>#$%&*" in First Name. 2. Enter a valid Last Name. 3. Click Save.
Expected Result: Application either rejects the input with a validation message or safely stores/escapes the value without breaking the UI or enabling script execution.
Actual Result: Record saved; special characters stored and displayed as plain text without breaking layout.

Title: Add employee with First Name exceeding maximum length (boundary)
Preconditions: User is logged in and on PIM > Add Employee
Steps: 1. Enter a First Name of 200+ characters. 2. Enter a valid Last Name. 3. Click Save.
Expected Result: Field enforces a maximum character limit (per field constraint) and either truncates input or shows a validation message before submission.
Actual Result: Validation message shown for exceeding max length.

Title: Search employee list for a non-existent name
Preconditions: User is logged in and on PIM > Employee List
Steps: 1. Enter a clearly non-existent name (e.g. zzzznotarealemployee999) in the employee search field. 2. Click Search.
Expected Result: Results table shows "No Records Found" (or equivalent), not an error or stale data.
Actual Result: No Records Found"" shown as expected.

Title: Add new user with mismatched Password and Confirm Password
Preconditions: User is logged in and on Admin > Add User
Steps: 1. Fill all required fields. 2. Enter Password "Abc12345!". 3. Enter Confirm Password "Abc99999!" (different). 4. Click Save.
Expected Result: Form does not submit; validation message indicates passwords do not match.
Actual Result: Validation message shown as expected; user not created.

Title: Add new user with weak/blank password
Preconditions: User is logged in and on Admin > Add User
Steps: 1. Fill all required fields except Password/Confirm Password (leave blank). 2. Click Save.
Expected Result: Form does not submit; ""Required"" validation shown for Password field.

Title: Delete a system user and verify removal
Preconditions: User is logged in and on Admin > User Management with at least one non-critical test user present
Steps: 1. Locate a test user row. 2. Click the delete (trash) action icon. 3. Confirm "Yes, Delete" on the confirmation dialog. 4. Re-search for the same username.
Expected Result: User record is permanently removed; subsequent search returns ""No Records Found"" for that username.
Actual Result: User removed and search returns no results.

Title: Apply for leave with From Date later than To Date
Preconditions: User is logged in and on Leave > Apply
Steps: 1. Select a valid Leave Type. 2. Set From Date to a later date than To Date (e.g. From = 2026-12-20, To = 2026-12-10). 3. Click Apply.
Expected Result: Form does not submit; validation message indicates To Date must not be before From Date.
Actual Result: Validation message shown; leave not created.

Title: Apply for leave without selecting a Leave Type
Preconditions: User is logged in and on Leave > Apply
Steps: 1. Leave Leave Type as "-- Select --". 2. Fill valid From/To dates. 3. Click Apply.
Expected Result: Form does not submit; ""Required"" validation message shown under Leave Type.

Title: Apply for leave using a past date (boundary/edge case)
Preconditions: User is logged in and on Leave > Apply
Steps: 1. Select a valid Leave Type with sufficient balance. 2. Enter a From/To date in the past (e.g. 2020-01-15). 3. Click Apply.
Expected Result: Application either blocks past-dated leave with a validation message, or explicitly allows it consistently without silently failing.
Actual Result: Not executed this cycle -- demo site was unresponsive during test execution window (see notes). To be re-run before sign-off.
